newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Distilleries up on heavy local buying.
newsitem.headline: Distilleries up on heavy local buying.

text.p: Distilleries Company of Sri Lanka Ltd rose four percent, or 25 cents to 6.50 on local buying of one million shares, brokers said.
"A rich local investor is taking a long-term position because the share offers good value at current levels," said a broker who declined to be named.
The company is Sri Lanka's largest producer and distributor of alcohol.
